run.rulesInOwnWords:
1. Ingest: add each tier's scheduled chunks for the cycle to its count. Counts may go over budget here.
2. Eviction: go through tiers 1 to 6 in order. If a tier holds more than its budget, cut it back to the budget and pass the excess to the next tier out (n+1). This happens in sequence, so a tier sees what was evicted into it before its own turn. Excess from tier 6 goes to the drop count.
3. Temperature check, using the counts after eviction: a COLD tier at or above its heat mark turns HOT. A HOT tier at or below its cool mark turns COLD. Otherwise the state stays the same (hysteresis). A tier changes state at most once per cycle, and every change is logged.
4. Compaction and promotion: using the counts at the start of the step and the states after step 3, each tier's amount is floor(count/4) if COLD and floor(count/2) if HOT. All six amounts are worked out first and then applied at the same time. Every tier loses its amount. COLD amounts go to the drop count. HOT amounts move into tier n-1, except tier 1's HOT amount, which is dropped. The budget is not enforced here.
5. Context reset: if the six counts add up to more than 38, every count becomes floor(count/2), the removed chunks are added to the drop count, and the cycle is logged. A total of exactly 38 does not trigger it.
All divisions round down.
